# Nomaan Qureshi

> {{ site.description }}

Nomaan Qureshi publishes as "M. Nomaan Qureshi" and "Mohammad Nomaan Qureshi"; these are the same person. He is a Research Engineer at Skild AI. He completed an MS in Robotics at Carnegie Mellon University, advised by George Kantor and Abhisesh Silwal, and an integrated BS at IIIT Hyderabad, where he worked at the Robotics Research Center with K. Madhava Krishna. His research goal is to solve robot manipulation.

- Homepage: {{ '/' | absolute_url }}
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=ZmVf8kUAAAAJ
- GitHub: https://github.com/qureshinomaan
- X / Twitter: https://twitter.com/qunomaan

## Publications

Each page below has a short summary, the abstract where available, questions and answers, links and a BibTeX entry. Each page also has an interactive visual that illustrates the paper's idea with a toy model. The SplatSim page runs the paper's real robot workspace capture as Gaussian splats in the browser, with the robot's splats attached to its kinematic chain; the RTVS and Imagine2Servo pages show visual servoing with optical flow inside real captured scenes. When citing a paper, please cite the paper itself using the BibTeX on its page.
